name: Khushiyon Ki Sawari Sewa - Uttarakhand
benefit: Under this scheme, pregnant women are provided free transportation from the hospital to their homes along with their newborns after delivery. Additionally, pregnant are also provided free to-and-fro transportation from home to the hospital for ultrasound services. These facilities are being provided across the state through 128 vehicles.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman or a newborn baby aged 0 to 1 year.
